kjv: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

lines.say: Tired and discouraged tonight? This is for you.
Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD. Psalm thirty one, verse twenty four.
lines.big: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.

lines.say: Courage doesn't always look loud. Sometimes it's just hoping one more night.
lines.big: Courage doesn't always look loud. Sometimes it's just hoping one more night.

lines.say: Lord, strengthen my heart tonight. My hope is in you. In Jesus' name, amen.
Want the Word playing while you sleep? Psalms 1 through 31, read slowly, is on our channel. The link is in the description.
